description: The xRegistry model for the RubyGems wrapper, describing the structure and metadata for Ruby gem registries and packages.

rubyregistries.description: A group representing a Ruby gem registry provider (e.g., rubygems.org).

sourceurl.description: Base URL of the gem source from which these gems were projected, e.g. 'https://rubygems.org'. This records provenance only; a gem name denotes the same gem whichever source serves it.

packages.description: A Ruby gem in the registry, including its metadata and available versions.

name.description: The canonical gem name exactly as published. This is the authoritative name of the gem; the packageid is only an addressing key derived from it.

info.description: The gemspec 'summary': a one-line summary of the gem. The RubyGems JSON API returns this under the name 'info'. This is NOT the gemspec 'description'; see the separate 'description' attribute.

description.description: The gemspec 'description': the long-form description of the gem. The RubyGems JSON API returns it alongside, and distinct from, 'info' (the summary).

version.description: Latest stable version string of the gem, as reported by GET /api/v1/gems/<gem>.json.

full_name.description: The gem file base name as published: '<name>-<number>' for the default 'ruby' platform and '<name>-<number>-<platform>' otherwise. This is the upstream-formed name of the (version, platform) tuple; it is not derived from 'versionid'.

authors.description: Comma-separated list of authors, preserved in the upstream form.

licenses.description: The gemspec 'licenses' list. NULLABLE upstream: a gem may declare no licenses at all, in which case this attribute is absent. RubyGems only RECOMMENDS SPDX identifiers and does not enforce them; each entry is a free-form short license name of at most 64 characters, and 'LicenseRef-' values are permitted. Consumers MUST NOT assume an entry is a valid SPDX identifier.

gem_uri.description: Direct download URL for the .gem file of this version and platform.

version_downloads.description: Download count for the latest version, as reported by the gem-level endpoint.

platform.description: Build platform of this release, exactly as published, e.g. 'ruby', 'java', 'x86_64-linux'. 'ruby' is the default pure-Ruby build; 'java' is the JRuby build.

spec_sha.description: SHA-256 checksum of the compiled gemspec (the .gemspec.rz entry) of this release.

ruby_version.description: The gemspec 'required_ruby_version' requirement string, e.g. '>= 3.1.0'. Resolution-affecting: a consumer that ignores it MAY select a release the target interpreter cannot run. It MUST be preserved verbatim and MUST NOT be split or rewritten.

rubygems_version.description: The gemspec 'required_rubygems_version' requirement string, e.g. '>= 3.0.0'. Resolution-affecting in the same way as 'ruby_version'. It MUST be preserved verbatim and MUST NOT be split or rewritten.

requirements.description: The gemspec 'requirements' list: free-form, human-readable statements of external non-gem prerequisites such as system libraries. Informational only; not machine-resolvable.

dependencies.description: Runtime and development dependencies keyed by type. The split is significant and MUST be preserved. RETRIEVAL COST: GET /api/v1/versions/<gem>.json does NOT return dependencies, so populating this attribute requires one GET /api/v2/rubygems/<gem>/versions/<number>.json request per (version, platform) tuple. This attribute MAY therefore be absent.

number.description: Raw version string as published to RubyGems.

prerelease.description: True if this is a pre-release version.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this version was published to the registry.

built_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp recorded in the gemspec at build time. This is asserted by the publisher and MAY differ from 'created_at', which is the registry's publication time.

downloads_count.description: Download count for this specific version+platform.

yanked.description: True if this version has been yanked from RubyGems. AVAILABILITY: GET /api/v1/versions/<gem>.json does not return a yanked flag, and the compact index never reports yanked positively - a yanked release is simply absent from the index. Determining this per release requires one GET /api/v2 request per (version, platform) tuple. This attribute MAY therefore be absent, and its absence MUST NOT be read as 'not yanked'.

homepage_uri.description: The gemspec metadata key 'homepage_uri'. Declared per release, so its value MAY differ between versions of the same gem.

source_code_uri.description: The gemspec metadata key 'source_code_uri'. Declared per release and commonly pinned to the release tag, e.g. '.../tree/v8.1.3.1', so its value MAY differ between versions of the same gem.

changelog_uri.description: The gemspec metadata key 'changelog_uri'. Declared per release, so its value MAY differ between versions of the same gem.

documentation_uri.description: The gemspec metadata key 'documentation_uri'. Declared per release, so its value MAY differ between versions of the same gem.

bug_tracker_uri.description: The gemspec metadata key 'bug_tracker_uri'. Declared per release, so its value MAY differ between versions of the same gem.

metadata.description: The complete, verbatim gemspec 'metadata' hash for this release. The hash is OPEN and publisher-extensible: RubyGems assigns no fixed key set, and keys such as 'funding_uri', 'wiki_uri', 'mailing_list_uri' and 'rubygems_mfa_required' occur alongside the well-known *_uri keys. An implementation MUST copy every key through rather than projecting a fixed subset. RubyGems limits each key to 128 bytes and each value to 1024 bytes. The dedicated 'homepage_uri', 'source_code_uri', 'changelog_uri', 'documentation_uri' and 'bug_tracker_uri' attributes are convenience projections of the identically named keys and do not replace this map.

media_type.description: The media type of the attestation bundle.

bundle.description: The attestation bundle document, copied verbatim.

attestations.description: Sigstore attestations published with this release, when the registry supplies them.

defaultversionsticky.description: Sticky default Versions are not supported: the default Version is always the newest published version.

handle.description: The RubyGems.org user handle of the owner.

role.description: The owner's role on the gem.

owners.description: The users who may push this gem, as returned by GET /api/v1/gems/<gem>/owners.json. A gem MAY have several owners and the set is mutable, so ownership does not partition the gem namespace: gem names are flat and globally unique on RubyGems.org regardless of who owns them.

project_uri.description: The gem's page on the registry, e.g. https://rubygems.org/gems/<gem>. This URL is SYNTHESISED BY THE REGISTRY from the gem name; it is not a gemspec metadata key and is not declared by the publisher. It is therefore modelled apart from the publisher-declared *_uri attributes.

downloads.description: Total download count across all versions and platforms.

reverse_dependencies.description: Names of gems that declare a dependency on this gem, as returned by GET /api/v1/gems/<gem>/reverse_dependencies.json. This is a registry-wide aggregate over the current index, not a property of any single release, and it changes as other gems are published.
